findings.message: event 'bus.Changed' is subscribed (handler 'OnC') to 'EventBus' — a DI singleton (application-lifetime) service that outlives 'VM'; the strong subscription promotes 'VM' to the source's lifetime, so it can never be collected — a captive/region escape (leak, no release path)
event 'cache.Evicted' is subscribed (handler 'OnE') but never unsubscribed; its source is an injected dependency whose lifetime is unknown, so it may outlive and keep 'VM' alive (possible leak)
